title: Complete parameterization and parameter-space topology of discrete Wigner representations on $d \times d$ phase space
summary: Toroidal discrete Wigner functions (DWFs) for finite-dimensional systems are non-unique. We completely parameterize and topologically classify the labeled single-qudit ${d\times d}$ representations whose phase-point operators are Hermitian, unit-trace, Hilbert--Schmidt orthogonal, and Weyl--Heisenberg covariant, determining the independent parameter freedom in every dimension. Our previously established stencil theorem expresses this family as descents of a doubled ${2d\times2d}$ parent Wigner representation.
